configure_model_settings: configure the SAFE fact-checking model settings including model_short, model_temp, and max_tokens
configure_search_settings: configure the SAFE search settings including search_type and num_searches for Google Search API
configure_safe_settings: configure the SAFE fact-checking settings including max_steps, max_retries, and debug_safe
resolve_model_name: resolve the full model name from model_short using shared_config.model_options
run_safe_fact_check: run the SAFE fact-checking pipeline with configured model, search, and safety settings
